facts.fact: BUTTONFLY的手下Ebenezer Z. MYPLACEORYOURS准时到新德里Le Méridien的eau de Monsoon餐厅与KRAY吃午饭，并带来一份相当体面的掩护身份提案。
facts.anchor: BUTTONFLY’s guy, Ebenezer Z. MYPLACEORYOURS, showed up for lunch at Le Méridien’s eau de Monsoon restaurant right on time and with a very respectable cover proposal.

facts.fact: MYPLACEORYOURS因一位叙利亚发展官员临时邀他去钓鱼，躲过了1983年4月美国驻贝鲁特大使馆的爆炸。
facts.anchor: on account of a spur of the moment fishing invitation from a Syrian developmental, he had escaped being blown to bits in April 1983 at the U.S. Embassy in Beirut, Lebanon.

facts.fact: KRAY又点了一杯酒，把LIFTSHITS Manhattan介绍给酒店老板；他自己不抽烟，却接过一支烟并用那支金打火机点着。
facts.anchor: He ordered another drink and then introduced the hotel owner to the joys of the LIFTSHITS Manhattan. Even though he didn’t smoke, KRAY accepted a cigarette and lit it with the lighter.

facts.fact: KRAY在瓦拉纳西的酒店房间里丢下了KANDINSKY为他织的灰色V领突击队员毛衣。
facts.anchor: KRAY managed to leave behind in a hotel room the grey v-neck commando sweater KANDINSKY had knitted for him

facts.fact: KRAY为给美国政府省点钱，坐三等车厢从新德里经阿格拉到瓦拉纳西。
facts.anchor: KRAY rode the train from New Delhi to Varanasi via Agra, traveling Third Class to save the U.S. government a little money.

facts.fact: KRAY用仿制OSS短剑撬卡住的车窗，结果刀刃断成两截。
facts.anchor: whereupon the blade of his stiletto snaps in half.

facts.fact: KRAY吃下那张家常薄饼后连续病了三整天，之后靠几天Cipro疗程和大量瓶装水才恢复。
facts.anchor: he was sick through three straight days of feeling like a human shipwreck.

facts.fact: 印度保安Sankar（Blazer Guy）要求取回打火机，KRAY从口袋掏出他在Nero酒吧改作自用的24K金打火机，耸耸肩交还。
facts.anchor: He reached into his pocket, pulled out the 24-carat gold lighter he had converted for his own use at the Nero bar, and handed it over, shrugging.
